retrievalProfile.description: A central figure surrounded by hooded silhouettes within a surreal, pink-toned environment distorted by a heavy radial motion blur vortex.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered male figure stands in a suburban driveway, flanked by symmetrical rows of faceless hooded figures. The entire scene, except for the central subject's face and torso, is warped by a circular motion blur that creates a tunnel-like effect. The color palette is dominated by desaturated pinks and magentas in the foliage and ground, contrasting with the subject's neutral clothing.
coreVisualRelationships: Central subject as the stable anchor amidst motion
Symmetrical arrangement of hooded figures creating depth
Radial blur lines converging on the central figure's head
High contrast between the dark silhouettes and the bright pink environment
coreInvariants: Radial motion blur centered on the subject
Infrared-style pink/magenta color shift in organic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is centered vertically and horizontally, full-body shot at medium scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and red hat serve as the sharpest point of focus.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The radial blur forces the eye from the outer edges inward toward the center point.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blurred driveway and sky act as active negative space, providing the texture for the motion effect.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark greens (hooded figures)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the center, transitioning to darker, heavily textured edges.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to pink, black, white, and muted blue

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single utilitarian font family for regulatory labeling.
graphicDevices: Rectangular black box with white border

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for a compact warning label.
Offers a clean, industrial look that matches standard advisory formatting.
Strong legibility at small scales within a contained box.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man in a red hat and light jacket standing in a driveway, surrounded by 5-6 hooded figures. Apply a heavy radial blur centered on the man's face. Color grade the trees and ground to a desaturated pink/magenta infrared look.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small black rectangular box in the bottom right corner with a white border. Inside, place three lines of white condensed sans-serif text, centered.

verificationChecks: Is the radial blur centered on the main subject?
Are the trees and ground pink instead of green?
Is the text box in the bottom right corner?
Are the secondary figures faceless silhouettes?

adjustableVariables: Hue of the infrared effect (pink to red)
Clothing color of the central subject
mustRedesign: Any specific logos on the hat
Identifiable facial features of the background figures

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the central subject's torso/head
avoid: Uniform blur across the whole image
Cluttered background elements that break the symmetry

postGenerationChecks: Check that the radial blur does not obscure the central subject's face.
Ensure the pink color grading is applied to all organic textures.
Verify the text box is legible and correctly positioned.
Confirm the hooded figures appear as dark, ominous silhouettes.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject + Symmetrical silhouettes + Radial motion blur + Infrared color shift + Bottom-right metadata block.
